test_RoCBertTokenizer_full_tokenization: test the RoCBertTokenizer to tokenize Chinese text and convert tokens to ids, shape ids, and pronunciation ids
test_RoCBertBasicTokenizer_chinese_chars: test the RoCBertBasicTokenizer to split Chinese characters individually from mixed alphanumeric text
test_RoCBertBasicTokenizer_lowercasing: test the RoCBertBasicTokenizer with lowercasing and accent stripping options on mixed case text
test_RoCBertWordpieceTokenizer_subword: test the RoCBertWordpieceTokenizer to split words into subword tokens using a vocabulary file
test_tokenizer_sequence_builders: test the RoCBertTokenizer sequence builders to encode single and paired sentences with special tokens
